description: GeoWorks est une équipe basée à Yaoundé qui met les données satellitaires de la NASA au service d’une agriculture de précision accessible aux producteurs camerounais.
summary: MaisMap is an interactive agricultural decision-support prototype designed to help farmers and agricultural stakeholders in Northern Cameroon make more informed crop-planning decisions. It combines daily rainfall and temperature information from NASA POWER with soil-property data from ISRIC SoilGrids to provide a geographic view of local climate and soil conditions. Through an interactive map and data visualizations, MaïsMap helps users explore environmental risks relevant to maize production and assess the suitability of different crop-planning and rotation options. By bringing climate and soil information together in one accessible platform, the project aims to support more resilient farming decisions, encourage sustainable soil management, and help communities adapt to changing environmental conditions.
details:
MaïsMap brings together climate and soil information to support agricultural decision-making in Northern Cameroon.

The platform uses NASA POWER daily meteorological data, including precipitation and temperature, to explore rainfall patterns and climate-related risks. It also integrates extracted ISRIC SoilGrids data to provide soil context, including available soil-property indicators.

The information is processed with Python and prepared for geographic visualization. GeoJSON is used to exchange spatial data, while Streamlit provides the application interface and Folium supports interactive maps. QGIS is used for geographic data inspection and cartographic validation.

The project is intended to help users:

  • Explore climate conditions and rainfall variability across the study area.
  • Visualize available soil-property information geographically.
  • Understand how climate and soil conditions can inform agricultural planning.
  • Examine crop-rotation options in the context of local environmental conditions.
  • Support more sustainable and climate-aware agricultural decisions.

Our goal is to make environmental data easier to understand and use, especially for agricultural communities that need accessible information to adapt their practices.
